name: Sandro Ruotolo - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the impact of social media and the online environment on young people
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position on how social media affects children and young people. It is not a law: it asks the European Commission and member states to act. It wants existing rules enforced better, a common minimum age for social media across the EU, privacy-friendly age checks, safer default settings for minors, a ban on advertising aimed at children, and more teaching of digital skills in schools.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks for new laws, better enforcement and a common EU minimum age.
- **Who it affects:** Children and teenagers, parents, schools, social media platforms, influencers and game makers.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and member states decide whether to act on these requests.
